text:
Maria: Quick async standup — posting early during quiet shift. What I did: cleaned up canary routing rules for eu-west, adjusted kv-eviction thresholds. Blockers: saw two 504s during warmup, unsure if autoscaler or batcher. Today: follow up with Jin on autoscaler logs and get PR reviewed for the config change.

Sam: Noted the 504s, saw a matching spike at 03:12 UTC. Captured a snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:12:15Z router ERROR upstream 504 batcher_timeout retry=1 trace=abc123
```
Adding trace tagging now. @Jin can you check batcher backpressure metrics? :mag:

Jin: On it. Pulling metrics and checking per-instance queue depth. If it's autoscaler, we should see scale events around those times. Merged a small fix for queue reporter (PR #452) — needs one extra review from Priya before it goes to prod.

Priya: I'll take a look at #452 this morning. Also found the runbook entry for `batcher_timeouts` has stale thresholds — proposing detection threshold be lowered 5s -> 3s so we catch regressions faster. Thoughts?

Maria: Lowering to 3s ok for detection but could cause noise. Suggest we set the alert to P2 with a 10m suppression window initially and watch for noise. If rate stays actionable, promote to P1.

OncallBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0318-17 — batcher_timeouts > 3s (auto-suppressed via rule). Link: https://incidents.example/INC-2026-0318-17

Sam: Logistics note — infra is rolling a low-risk kernel patch tonight. Can we hold the low-priority eviction rollout until infra confirms?

Jin: I'll ping infra. Also Maria, after your kv threshold change, did you touch warm-up padding? I noticed a slight cold-hit increase in test rigs.

Maria: I bumped warm-up padding from 4 -> 6 steps. Net cold-hit increase ~2% on test rigs. Will revert if production shows >5%.

Priya: CR ping @Sam @Maria — can you review my documentation update: /docs/runbooks/batcher_timeouts.md? Two small sections: 'how to triage' and 'revert checklist'.

Sam: Reviewing now. Small nit for triage steps — add the curl command to fetch instance metrics:
```
curl -sS http://metrics.internal/instance/$ID | jq '.queue_depth, .latency'
```

Maria: Thanks. No other blockers from my side. If INC escalates I'll be on-call for the next handover. Otherwise I plan to tidy the canary tags and ship the config change.

Jin: I'll post back with graphs within 30m and label suspect nodes. If autoscaler misfires we can apply a temporary scale-up.

Priya: Thanks team — I'll prioritize the runbook and PR review. :thumbsup: 

Sam: TL;DR follow-ups: Jin checks metrics + graphs, Priya reviews doc + PR, Sam pings infra, Maria monitors canary & alerts. I'll post in #incidents once infra replies.

Maria: Great, thx all. :sparkles:
